shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat/vertical surface
repeated curved/linear elements arranged over the field
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow relief carving that includes disc/rosette-like circular forms, but A depicts an anthropomorphic figure with a head, face, arms and body ornaments (a belt-like band, a large central disc on the chest, incised bands and glyph-like marks), while B shows a purely vegetal repeating scheme of long-stemmed flowers with radiating petals and palmette-like fans filling the panel. The one shared specific element, a radiating disc, is generic and appears in wholly different contexts (worn on a body versus a floral head on a stalk), and the modes of depiction, figural-symbolic versus botanical-ornamental, are unrelated.
